# DATRUM

> B2B marketing product design and engineering studio, based in Panama City,
> Panama. Operated solo by Julio Luque Valdés across four disciplines that are
> normally split across separate vendors: design, front-end engineering,
> marketing strategy, and data architecture. Bilingual EN/ES. The thesis is
> that marketing should be built as an appreciating asset rather than rented
> attention.

DATRUM builds durable digital assets for B2B service providers whose buyers
vet them online before the first contact — jewelers and watch dealers, sports
executives, film producers, and fiduciary professionals with international
clients. Work spans presence architecture, structured data and answer-engine
legibility, security-header and privacy compliance (including Panama's Ley 81),
and bespoke instruments.

Every page on this site exists in English and Spanish. Spanish is written
natively, not machine-translated. The Spanish mirror of any URL is the same
path prefixed with `/es/`.

## Services and work

- [Services](https://jldatrum.com/work/#services): six engagement types, from a single product to full presence architecture, plus the four-pillar DATRUM Method.
- [Case studies](https://jldatrum.com/work/): seven engagements — what was broken, what was built, what changed.
- [Bio](https://jldatrum.com/bio/): background of the operator — contemporary art and photography training, investment brokerage, then cybersecurity and IT.

## Instruments (free, no forms)

- [AI Visibility Self-Diagnostic](https://jldatrum.com/resources/visibility/): 25-point assessment of whether a machine can parse, classify and cite a business.
- [Ley 81 Compliance Checklist](https://jldatrum.com/resources/ley81/): six-principle self-assessment against Panama's data protection law.
- [Security Header Reference](https://jldatrum.com/resources/security-headers/): the six headers institutional buyers scan for, with deployable config.
- [Brand Audit Scorecard](https://jldatrum.com/audit/): five-question diagnostic with a generated report.
